review: clues: machine-written (Claude) in en, with sl translations, from the mountain rescue hut in its Lakeland look (the orange stretcher on its one wheel where the pump stands, the red and blue coils of rope, the red helmets and jackets on their pegs, the two ice axes crossed, the red first-aid bags with their white cross, the map of the fells, the whistle on its cord on the nail, St George's cross, MRT over the big doors, the little bell tower of grey stone under slate); the sl translations keep to forms that don't give the word's gender away where they can; not reviewed by a native speaker

clues.en: It's orange.
It has one wheel, under its middle.
It has handles at both ends.
It's in the middle of the hall.
We carry a hurt walker on it.
It's red and blue.
It's very long.
It lies in big coils.
One end lies across the floor.
It holds a person on a steep rock.
clues.sl: Na strmi skali to drži človeka.

clues.en: They're red.
They hang on pegs on the wall.
We wear them on our heads.
They keep our heads safe from falling stones.
clues.sl: To nam varuje glavo pred kamni, ki padajo.

clues.en: There are two of them, crossed.
They're made of metal and wood.
Each one has a sharp point.
We take them up the fells in winter, for the ice.
clues.sl: Pozimi jih nesemo v hribe, za led.

clues.en: It's made of wood.
It's long.
It has a lot of rungs.
We climb up it.
They're red, with a white cross.
clues.sl: Rdeče barve so, z belim križem.

clues.en: They're on a shelf.
There are plasters and bandages inside.
We open them when someone is hurt.
clues.sl: To odpremo, ko se kdo poškoduje.

clues.en: It's at the top of the little tower.
A rope hangs down from it.
It goes ding, dong!
It calls the team when a walker is lost.
clues.sl: To pokliče ekipo, ko se pohodnik izgubi.

clues.en: They're very big.
There are three letters over them: MRT.
clues.sl: Nad tem so tri črke: MRT.

clues.en: They open in the morning and shut at night.
clues.sl: Zjutraj se odprejo, ponoči se zaprejo.

clues.en: The team goes out through them.
It's made of grey stone.
It has a roof of slate.
The bell is at the top.
It's outside, next to the hall.
They're red.
They hang on pegs.
We put them on before a rescue.
You can see them from far away on the fell.
clues.sl: V hribih jih vidiš od daleč.

clues.en: It's white, with a red cross.
clues.sl: Je bele barve, z rdečim križem.

clues.en: It's St George's.
It's England's.
The fells are drawn on it.
It has paths and lakes on it.
clues.sl: Na tem so poti in jezera.

clues.en: It hangs on the wall.
We read it before we go up a fell.
clues.sl: To preberemo, preden gremo na hrib.

clues.en: It's made of wood.
It's long.
We sit on it and put our boots on.
clues.sl: Na tem sedimo in si obuvamo čevlje.

clues.en: It's very small.
It hangs on a nail, on its cord.
It's very loud.
Six blasts on it mean: help!
clues.sl: Šest piskov s tem pomeni: na pomoč!

clues.en: It's made of metal and glass.
It gives light in the dark.
We light it at night, till the team comes home.
clues.sl: Ponoči to prižgemo, dokler se ekipa ne vrne.

clues.en: It's made of glass.
We can see outside through it.
It lets the light in.
